title: frangula glaberrima
intro: Frangula glaberrima, commonly known as yellow buckthorn or smooth buckthorn, is a plant species within the Rhamnaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include the ability to act as a laxative, help lower blood sugar levels, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Frangula glaberrima are attributed to its anthraquinone glycosides, which stimulate bowel movements and exert anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents of Frangula glaberrima include anthraquinone glycosides, such as emodin and aloe-emodin, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
